text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Daiwa Scarlet and Air Groove
talking on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... How was my form, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, your running looks
well-balanced. But on the other hand,
it's so curated that it lacks

specialization.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Specialization?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How should I put this... There was no you in that run. Like you weren't playing to your strengths.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me! What do you think my
strengths
are?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!
choice_data_list: I want to hear Air Groove's opinio...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Don't scare me like that, Trainer! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It's impolite to interject yourself
into someone else's conversation.
However, given
your passion as a trainer,
I'll forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: P-passion?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, Scarlet. When I see you running
with Vodka,
I see more of your self shine
through than I did
just now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have the drive to always be a step
ahead of
your opponent, and the
courage to take up every
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That's all I can tell you two.
It's up to
you to
decide what to do with the
information.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Think on it hard. For her sake.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: R-right! Let's get started, Trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: Alright, let's talk over our futur...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: R-right! Let's get started, Trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: For now, let's run on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Uh, and what is that supposed to mean?!
Are you
implying that I don't normally
listen to you?
choice_data_list: For now, let's run on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! I-I was just, uh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Keep up the good work, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! See what you did?! I'm all flustered
because
of you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not fine! Hmph! Now you need to
make up
for what you've done.
choice_data_list: Just like usual is totally fine, i...
Just like usual is totally fine, i...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and make a training program
that makes
use of Air Groove's notes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her seemingly foul mood, Daiwa
Scarlet
gives everything she has in the
ensuing training.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What?! Just like that?! Didn't you just say we're going to discuss the training regimen?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're always like this! Randomly
deciding things
for me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And today, you interrupted me right
when I was in
the middle of talking with
Air―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! I-I was just, uh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Keep up the good work, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! This is your fault for making me
mad!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And right in front of Air Groove too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
At least say you're sorry! Geez, this is
exactly
what I mean...
